coverage.evidence: Both pages sit in the settings.access nav group (dashboard/src/layouts/dashboard/settingsNavigation.ts:82-90; group label Access at dashboard/src/i18n/locales/en.json:961) and their crumb is Moderation (automod/i18n/en.json:5, chat-filters/i18n/en.json:5). Default access comes from server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Content/Identity/ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:253-256 and 418-419: read is Mod, write is LeadModerator, twitch:manage is Broadcaster. The UI gates are AutomodView.vue:51,94,114 and 215, TwitchAutomodPanel.vue:42,123 and 133, and ChatFiltersView.vue:49,90,96 and 120-140. Saving takes effect at once because ModerationService.cs:868-874 publishes the automod config-changed event and AutoModRuleCacheInvalidator.cs:31-50 evicts the cache. The Twitch levels have their own Save Twitch levels button (TwitchAutomodPanel.vue:93-102), and the page Save sends only the four filters (automodDraft.ts:52-60).

The editor flow, its labels and its defaults match ChatFilterEditor.vue:133-263, chat-filters/i18n/en.json:6-75 and chatFilterDraft.ts:51-67: Blocklist, Delete, 600, Moderator, bare domains on, case off, enabled on. The editor refusals come from chatFilterDraft.ts:96-116, and the server refusal of a bad regex from ChatFilterService.cs:88-93 and 212-226. The Never filter choices are listed at api/permissions.ts:32-39 and chatFilterDraft.ts:36-38, and the exemption check is senderLevel >= ExemptMinRoleLevel at ChatFilterExecutionHandler.cs:112.

ChatFilterExecutionHandler.cs:86-87 returns early for the broadcaster and moderators. Lines 93-96 read the enabled filters from the database on every message, with no cache and no live-stream check. The row switch sends only isEnabled (api/chatFilters.ts:120-126). The handler is not onboarding-exempt, and EventBus.cs:49-70 drops it for a Twitch channel that has not onboarded.

Try it sends the unsaved draft through toRequest (ChatFilterEditor.vue:87-105). TestPattern only evaluates the text, with no role, exemption or enforcement input (ChatFilterService.cs:286-351). The controller persists nothing (ChatFiltersController.cs:154-160). The match, no-match and compile-error texts are at chat-filters/i18n/en.json:72-74.

Subdomain allow and one-bad-link-trips are at AutoModerationHandler.cs:179-205 and LinkPolicy.cs AllowsHost/IsTrippedBy. Substring and any-case matching are at AutoModerationHandler.cs:229-238 and ChatFilterExecutionHandler.cs:460-473. The regex case option is at ChatFilterExecutionHandler.cs:445-448, and the caps rules (5 letters, min_length 10, 70 percent) at AutoModerationHandler.cs:141-165. The oldest enabled filter wins and an exempt filter is skipped (ChatFilterExecutionHandler.cs:95 and 110-135), while the list shows newest first (ChatFilterService.cs:49). The count only rises when the action was enforced (ChatFilterExecutionHandler.cs:129-133).

The Twitch AutoMod panel describes Twitch holding messages (automod/i18n/en.json:15). Hold deletes and then queues the message, Twitch only (ChatFilterExecutionHandler.cs:158-161 and 265-275). Flag on a non-Twitch message returns false without queueing (lines 163-176). Escalate on a non-Twitch message, or when the ladder is off or fails, uses the filter timeout (lines 311-351, and ModerationEscalationService.cs:42-51). With no stored length that timeout is 600 seconds (lines 65 and 412).
